hints.title: Prefix Tree Directory Hierarchy
hints.text: Represent nested directories and files using an n-ary tree where directories contain children maps and files store accumulated text content.

hints.title: Path Tokenization and Traversal
hints.text: Split path strings by slash delimiters. Traverse down child nodes, creating missing directories as needed for mkdir or addContentToFile.

hints.title: File System Operations Blueprint
hints.text: Each node has is_file flag, content string, and children dict. ls(path) navigates to node: if is_file return [name], else return sorted(children.keys()).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: number of entries in directory
complexity.notes: Path traversal takes O(L); directory listing sorts K children in O(K log K) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flat dictionary storage cannot efficiently support hierarchical directory listings or nested mkdir.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trie nodes allocate space proportional to unique folder and file paths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean separation between directory nodes and file nodes with string content concatenation.

solutions.approach: Java TreeMap Trie Tree Directory Model
